summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **Does Data Scaling Lead to** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖分布外泛化（Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Generalization）。核心论点主张：The dominant machine learning paradigm is built on the premise that scaling data and model sizes will improve out-of-distribution performance, including compositional...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We test this premise through controlled experiments that systematically vary data scale, concept diversity, and combination coverage。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We find that compositional generalization is driven by data diversity, not mere data scale）。
